title: Quality rates depend on how answers were sampled
method: Synthetic independently described samples. Rates are 18/200 × 100 = 9% and 30/50 × 100 = 60%. The reported-answer sample is selected and must not be pooled as if it were random traffic.
alt: Quality rates depend on how answers were sampled. Random sample: 18/200: 9 percent unsupported, Reports: 30/50: 60 percent unsupported. Illustrative data.
